mode: diagnostic L1 ACLGraph, per-replay external synchronization

metadata.caller_quiesce: stream synchronize after at most 20 enqueues
metadata.cold_path_boundary: compile/PTOAS/codegen, binary registration/materialization/loading, runtime/context/owner/callable creation and prepare, weight packing/preparation, ordinary eager/ACLGraph/benchmark warmup, optional ACLGraph capture/build, correctness generation/execution/comparison/validation-only copies, the first invocation/replay at final sampled addresses, one-time structure/binding-cache population, and timing-event/runtime-handle initialization all complete and caller-quiesce before SamplingPhase.SAMPLE
metadata.device_span_semantics: pre-created same-stream NPU timing events surround each full op/replay; host_enqueue and device_span are overlapping views and must not be added
metadata.external_input_update: no backend-specific update is required in this steady workload: input is already device-resident; only backend-independent, byte-identical correctness/phase-reset fixture copies are outside timing
metadata.graph_replay_semantics: N/A in eager; in aclgraph aliases host_enqueue because the enqueue is exactly graph.replay
metadata.host_enqueue_semantics: producer-side full custom-op call through taskQueue in eager; exact graph.replay enqueue in aclgraph
metadata.measurement_contract: {"captured_binding": "fixed", "compile_in_acceptance": false, "correctness_gate_completed_before_sampling": true, "event_handles_primed_by_benchmark_warmup": true, "excluded_setup": ["program compile", "PTOAS/codegen", "binary registration, materialization, and loading", "runtime/context/owner creation, prepare, and callable setup", "weight packing and preparation", "ordinary eager warmup", "ACLGraph warmup", "ACLGraph capture and graph construction", "first invocation/replay at the final sampled addresses", "one-time structure/binding-cache population", "timing-event pool and runtime-handle initialization", "benchmark warmup iterations", "correctness golden generation, execution, comparison, and validation-only copies"], "first_final_binding_primed": true, "formal_acceptance_supported": true, "goal": "steady_state_only", "host_enqueue_and_device_span_are_non_additive": true, "included_repeated_path": ["per-call validation required by the production path", "tensor-address and scalar patching required by the production path", "taskQueue enqueue and dequeue", "AICPU/AICore device scheduling", "kernel execution", "repeated binding-cache replacement or cache miss caused by the measured workload"], "pre_sample_quiesced": true, "primary_metric": "device_span", "sample_phase": "sample", "warmup_in_acceptance": false}
metadata.metadata_update_semantics: separate static no-op boundary: B4/S8 external metadata does not change; wrapper metadata binding and tensor/scalar/address argument patch work is not precomputed and remains inside host_enqueue
metadata.native_device_span_coverage: caller-stream tail event is complete: every production DSA auxiliary-stream branch joins back to the caller stream before dsa_forward returns
metadata.native_path: production vllm::dsa_forward with default multistream overlap enabled
metadata.per_call_patch_coverage: ACLGraph replays the already-captured fixed B4/S8 tensor/scalar snapshot; there is no per-replay Python metadata/address/scalar patch to move outside timing

metadata.state_worlds: independent equal weights/input; disjoint mutable caches/output
metadata.steady_state_statistics: p50/p90/p99 are computed only from SamplingPhase.SAMPLE; cold setup and the separately retained SamplingPhase.WARMUP series never contribute
metadata.task_queue_contract: TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1 as required by torch_npu 2.12 ACLGraph capture; steady replay is graph.replay()
metadata.task_queue_coverage: host_enqueue is exactly graph.replay; device_span covers dequeue/launch of captured nodes plus device execution; the post-tail-event caller synchronization only collects/quiesces completed event work and is not reported as a latency metric
